body_markdown:
Rethink the holiday dinner centerpiece this year with a little help from Lifeway, and experience a feast unlike any other. This Thanksgiving, swap the standard marinade for a game-changing secret weapon:[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) . Thanks to its natural tanginess and creamy texture, kefir gently tenderizes poultry into melt-in-your-mouth perfection while locking in moisture to optimize the flavor and texture. We call this[kefir brine](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/turkey-brine/) , and it performs just like a traditional buttermilk soak, delivering ultra-juicy meat beneath crisp, beautifully caramelized skin without any complicated culinary tricks.


No matter how you season your Thanksgiving turkey, a kefir brine made with any variety of[Lifeway Plain kefir (whole milk or lowfat)](https://lifewaykefir.com/all-products/) transforms the average main dish into something extra special for the holidays. The live and active[probiotics](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/probiotics) in Lifeway Kefir work wonders in the prep stage, breaking down tough fibers so every carve is foolproof and flavorful.[Lifeway Kefir Butter](https://lifewaykefir.com/lifewaykefirbutter/) is also a delicious way to upgrade your turkey and ensure it comes out moist on the inside and perfectly browned with a slight crisp on the outside.


### The Ultimate Turkey Upgrade: Brining Your Turkey with Lifeway Kefir and Kefir Butter


We’ve rounded up some of our favorite recipes this year from Lifeway’s community of creators so you can see how effortless —and delicious—it is to make a turkey with Lifeway. Whether you prefer a simple brine, sweet citrus infusion, or bold, smoky aromatics, making Lifeway the foundation of your holiday feast guarantees a show-stopping centerpiece. Gather your loved ones, elevate your holiday tradition, and get ready for rave reviews around the Thanksgiving table.
